player_prompt.intro:
Waxaad tahay Player {player_id} oo ka soo horjeeda ciyaar Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Calaamadkaaga waa '{symbol}'.
Waxa ugu muhiimsan inaad joojiso inaad hesho saddex kuwa ka mid ah (sawir, verticale, ama diagonal).
Haddii aad sameysato saddex kuwa ka mid ah, waxaad ku adkaataan.
Gudbi waxaad sameynayso ku shaqaaleysan formadda '[4]' si aad u geli doonto calaamadkaaga ee cell 4.
Waxaana Player {player_id}, waxaad '{symbol}' iyo adigaaga ugu horreeya '{opponent_symbol}'.

board.current_board: Guddiga hadda jira: {board} Dhaqdhaqaaqyada la heli karo: {moves}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaabka guuritaanka oo aan sax ahayn. Isticmaal '[cell]'.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Qolka {cell} waa mid horay loo qabsaday.

game_action.placed: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu calaamadiisa ({symbol}) ku dhigay unugga {cell}.

outcome.loss: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ayaa lumiya isagoo dhameystiraya khadka!
outcome.draw: waa la isku raacay, qofna ma dhumin.
